heuristics: Canonicalized parallel rho walk modeled as a uniform random function on an m=r/6-element set (standard, supported, not proven).

van Oorschot-Wiener's 'walks merge and stay merged' property (no collision is missed by only checking at distinguished points, only delayed by up to 1/theta steps) is the standard, well-established result, not independently re-proven beyond the toy-scale check.
Itemized per-step overhead (comparison, modular update, hash, DP check, escape bookkeeping) is a disclosed estimate, generously covered by a charged 2-field-multiplication slack.
limitations: This is a revision of rejected submission 16547c5b-f2c2-44b0-a5fc-36e43094af47; see proof.md's 'What was wrong, and the fix for each point' section for the complete mapping from objections to fixes.

Analytic construction; no full-size execution. experiment.py exercises the exact production mechanism (mixed branches, parallel walks, distinguished points, escape, linear solve) on a toy additive exponent group, not production curve arithmetic.
Success probability is exactly 0.39, verified to 60 digits of precision, not a higher margin.
